# Local ID-capture samples

Put JPEG/PNG files here so the analyzer can be checked against real photos.

**Do not add real government IDs to git.** This folder is gitignored except
this README. Use a printed mock ID, a sample template, or a charger/object
photo.

Suggested names:

- `sharp_id.jpg`
- `blurry_id.jpg`
- `charger.jpg`
- `dark_id.jpg`
